pages.title: Your display preferences
pages.intro: Open Settings to choose appearance, weather background and text size. These settings belong to this browser.
steps: Choose System, Light or Dark. System follows your device appearance.
Choose a weather background independently of appearance.
Choose 130% text and reload. Your display choices remain saved.
pages.expected: Display choices survive reload and an older build's legacy theme update.
pages.failure: A storage warning means the current choices work in memory but may not survive closing the browser.

pages.title: Compare hourly weather
pages.intro: The hourly chart compares today's forecast with yesterday. Only the chart scrolls horizontally.
steps: Scroll the chart to later hours, or focus it and use Left, Right, Home and End.
Read the highlighted value and the shared temperature axis.
Expand wind and humidity, or open the table for the same hourly values.
pages.expected: All supplied hours remain available. A missing temperature leaves a gap in the line.
pages.failure: A dash means no supplied value; a missing yesterday series does not produce an invented comparison. If the request fails, focus stays in the content; choose Retry to load and focus the chart.

pages.title: Read daily ranges
pages.intro: Daily bars use one temperature scale and one cool-to-warm gradient. Past days remain available.
steps: Choose Daily; the daily chart scrolls into view and receives keyboard focus. Today starts in the third column when the chart overflows.
Compare minimum, maximum and current temperature. Different morning/afternoon conditions have AM/PM labels; matching conditions share one icon.
Use Left/Right/Home/End or the table for temperatures, conditions, precipitation probability and amount.
pages.expected: Past probability is hidden. Equal morning and afternoon conditions use one icon.
pages.failure: An incomplete range has no bar. The missing value is a dash; any supplied extremum remains on the shared scale. A failed request keeps focus in the content; Retry returns focus to Daily after data arrives.

pages.title: Read air information
pages.intro: Open Air quality to compare the available pollutant readings and grade wording.
steps: Choose an available pollutant. Keyboard arrow keys move between radio choices.
Read its grade, value and source time.
Open the forecast table when forecast data is supplied.
pages.expected: The selected reading and table use the same supplied data and selected air unit.
pages.failure: Unavailable pollutants or life indices are omitted. Stale data remains visibly labelled.

pages.title: Make text easier to read
pages.intro: Text size in Settings is independent of device text size. Language and light/dark appearance can be changed together.
steps: Choose the language and 130% text size.
Check Weather, Air quality and Settings; scroll chart content as needed.
On iOS, the system comparison uses the nearest step: 23pt versus 17pt, approximately 135%.
pages.expected: App 130% scales PWA text by 1.3. The iOS system step is a separate comparison, not an exact 130% setting.
pages.failure: The installed Cordova app may keep fixed CSS text sizes. Device measurements are documented separately.

pages.title: Manage saved browser data
pages.intro: Settings offers export, import and deletion of saved browser data. Export a copy before deliberately deleting it.
steps: Request deletion. The confirmation opens with Cancel focused.
Use Cancel or Escape to keep your data and return focus to the trigger.
Confirm only when you intend to reset saved places, snapshots and display preferences.
pages.expected: Cancel preserves saved data. Confirm resets this browser's TodayWeather data.
pages.failure: Storage or import errors are reported. Import replaces saved places only after confirmation.

pages.title: Reproduce this version
pages.intro: Maintainers can reproduce the shared design-token consumer from a clean repository checkout. See the editable manual and dated evidence alongside this PDF.
steps: Install locked dependencies with npm ci, then run npm run typecheck and npm test.
Run npm run build:web; the token generation hooks run automatically.
Run the documented browser checks. Rebuild this PDF with python scripts/verification/pwa-manual-pdf.py.
pages.expected: Generated tokens are deterministic. The build contains the hashed Pretendard font and its OFL license.
pages.failure: A missing browser, Python package or device is a prerequisite failure, not a passing verification.

pages.title: Read hourly rain and snow
pages.intro: The forecast amount covers the hours reported by the weather service. Rain and snow can cover different periods.
steps: Open Hourly and read the rain/snow forecast cards.
A six-hour amount is labelled 6 hours. About marks an approximate sum; exact hourly rain has no approximation marker.
When no forecast hours are covered, read the rain probability instead.
pages.expected: The screenshot shows exact 2 mm hourly rain, 6-hour rain and snow, about 40.5 mm over 3 hours, and 65% probability.
pages.failure: Older responses keep 3-hour forecast labels and approximate shortest labels. Missing values are not invented.

pages.title: Read daily forecast coverage
pages.intro: Daily forecast amounts show the hours covered by the supplied data. A full day covers 24 hours.
steps: Open Daily and read the forecast period next to each amount.
About marks approximate rain or snow. Partial-day totals show their supplied covered hours.
After saving weather, an offline reload keeps these same labels.
pages.expected: The screenshot shows 5.5 mm rain and about 10 mm snow over 24 hours.
pages.failure: Older responses without period fields keep the unqualified forecast label. A missing amount shows probability when supplied.
